fichas.title: Bicycle Traffic Space
fichas.summary: Guidance for cycle-way widths according to riding conditions, including brisk one-way riding, overtaking or meeting oncoming bicycles, and use by bicycles with trailers. The traffic-space discussion also identifies a basic bicycle width and refers to cyclist height and movement margin.
uses: Allowing bicycles to overtake or meet oncoming bicycles
